headline: Pay-per-call Arc data for agents and developers.
description: Every service is a read-only x402 call priced in USDC on Arc: the price is quoted up front, the result is recoverable with its job token, and every purchase has a receipt. No account, no API key.

services.title: Arc market search
services.description: Filter and sort Arc mainnet token/USDC markets that traded in the last 7 days, from our own index of the trusted V3 factories and the V4 PoolManager

services.title: Best execution quote
services.description: Exact-input quote on Arc mainnet across every V3 fee tier of Arc V3 and Synthra (direct and two hops through USDC), the busiest V4 pools against USDC (ERC-20 or native), direct V4 token/token pools, and mixed two-hop routes through USDC that combine an Arc V3 pool and a V4 pool (or two V4 pools), each hop by its venue's own quoter at one pinned block

services.title: Creator profile
services.description: A TOLLY pad creator's track record on Arc mainnet: how many tokens it launched and, for the 50 most recent, each token's price, market cap, liquidity, 24 h volume, its peak close over the last 8 days and the drawdown from it, whether it still trades, holder indexing status, and the share of supply the creator still holds (balanceOf at one block); plus totals and fixed-rule flags

services.title: Market activity stream
services.description: A 10-minute live feed of Arc mainnet market events after the purchase: every swap on an indexed token/USDC market (side, USDC size, token amount, price, tx) and every new token/USDC market, and large transfers (tracked tokens worth >= $1,000, USDC >= $10,000), optionally filtered by tokens, kinds and minimum size

services.title: Token intelligence report
services.description: One Arc mainnet token: supply, price (from its most traded token/USDC market with at least $1,000 of USDC depth; for V4 markets the USDC their positions hold between the price and half of it), market cap, every indexed token/USDC market with liquidity and 24 h volume, its pools against other tokens (identity), launch facts, and holder metrics (count, top-1/top-10 share, HHI, top holders) from the full Transfer history, checked against totalSupply and balanceOf; computed during the call when the token is not indexed yet

services.title: Token pairs (prices and volume against other tokens)
services.description: The pools in which one Arc mainnet token trades against another token (not USDC) on the Arc V3 and Synthra factories and the V4 PoolManager (up to 50; by guarded 24 h USD volume, then 24 h swap count, then last swap): each pool's price in the counter token after its last swap, the USD price that implies through the counter token's own USDC market and its deviation from the token's direct USD price, and 24 h swaps and volume of each leg, in USD only when both legs' USD values agree

services.title: Token price candles
services.description: OHLCV candles for one Arc mainnet token from every swap on one token/USDC market (the most traded one with at least $1,000 of USDC depth, or the named market): 5m/15m over the last 8 days, 1h/4h/1d/1w over up to a year of history

services.title: Risk / evidence report
services.description: Verifiable observations about one Arc mainnet token at a pinned block: contract and proxy facts (EIP-1967/EIP-1167), owner(), privileged functions found in the bytecode, V4 hook permissions of its pools, liquidity, age, launch facts and holder concentration

services.title: Token holders history
services.description: Holder count, top-1 and top-10 share and HHI (0-10,000) of one Arc mainnet token at the end of each UTC day, for up to the last 365 days (today: so far)

services.title: Wallet intelligence
services.description: One Arc mainnet wallet: exact balances, all read at one block, for every token found for it (tokens whose holders we index + tokens it received in the last ~8 days + USDC and TOLLY), USD values from markets with at least $1,000 of measured USDC depth (not counted when the holding is worth over 10x that depth), its token transfers of the last ~24 h, and the TOLLY pad launches it created

services.title: Wallet token balances
services.description: Exact ERC-20 balances of one wallet for a bounded token list, all read at the same Arc block

services.title: Wallet trades and PnL
services.description: One Arc mainnet wallet's trades over the last 1-8 days, reconstructed from its own Transfer logs (a transaction where it sent USDC and received exactly one token is a buy, the reverse a sell), with per-token quantities, USDC spent and received, average buy price, realized PnL on what it sold out of its window buys, and unrealized PnL of the rest at the current price

services.title: Token research bundle
services.description: Everything an agent needs to judge one Arc mainnet token, in one call: the full token.intelligence.v3 report (price, market cap, markets, pools against other tokens, launch, holders), the token.risk.v2 report (contract powers, proxies, hooks, concentration, rule-based notes), token.ohlcv.v2 candles for the last 24 hours (1h) and 30 days (1d), and the token.pairs.v1 pools against other tokens

services.title: Token snapshots (batch)
services.description: Up to 50 Arc mainnet tokens in one call, each with: price from its most traded token/USDC market with at least $1,000 of USDC depth, 24 h change, market cap, measured liquidity, 24 h volume, market count, launch facts, holder summary (when fully indexed) and flags

services.title: Alerts (24 h subscription)
services.description: A 24-hour subscription to up to 10 alert rules on Arc mainnet: a token's price crossing above/below a level, moving by a percentage within 1 h/24 h, swaps or transfers above a USD size, new token/USDC markets (optionally from one launchpad), and any token or USDC movement of a wallet

services.title: Alerts renewal (+24 h)
services.description: Extends an alerts subscription by 24 hours and 500 more matches, for its holder (subscription id and token)

services.title: Launch token (prepare)
services.description: Validates a TOLLY pad launch on Arc mainnet at least as strictly as the pad (banned names and symbols, required logo URI, field lengths, the dev-buy cap the token's anti-snipe max wallet imposes) and returns UNSIGNED transactions for the creator to sign: an optional USDC approval for the dev buy, then createToken with a fresh random salt

services.title: Alerts (7 day subscription)
services.description: A 168-hour subscription to up to 10 alert rules on Arc mainnet: a token's price crossing above/below a level, moving by a percentage within 1 h/24 h, swaps or transfers above a USD size, new token/USDC markets (optionally from one launchpad), and any token or USDC movement of a wallet

services.title: Alerts (30 day subscription)
services.description: A 720-hour subscription to up to 10 alert rules on Arc mainnet: a token's price crossing above/below a level, moving by a percentage within 1 h/24 h, swaps or transfers above a USD size, new token/USDC markets (optionally from one launchpad), and any token or USDC movement of a wallet
